nvitk.segmentation.region_growing.IntensityPolarity¶
nvitk.segmentation.region_growing.region_grow_binary_mask(vessel_mask: np.ndarray, intensity: np.ndarray, *, intensity_frac: float, abs_floor: float | None = None, forbidden: np.ndarray | None = None, polarity: IntensityPolarity = 'hyperintense', seed_intensity_mask: np.ndarray | None = None) → int¶

Grow a boolean mask in-place using 6-connectivity and mean-seed intensity gate.

When seed_intensity_mask is set, the intensity mean (gate reference) is computed only on vessel_mask & seed_intensity_mask so bright auxiliary seeds (e.g. AComm) do not inflate the threshold.
